disclosure.title: Before you turn this on
disclosure.sees: What it checks: only the name of the app that comes to the front.
disclosure.notSees: What it does not check: screen content, anything you type, or apps you did not choose.
disclosure.why: Why: to ask you once when you open an app you chose, at the time you set.
disclosure.where: Where it stays: on this device only. Nothing is sent anywhere.
